entries.what: Jun opens the espresso bar at Heron & Grind at 6:15 and pulls Wes Arnaud's 7 a.m. cortado, then writes a budget on his phone notes capping Lola's Roll launch costs at $1,800 through November.
entries.outcome: Budget cap set in his notes app.

entries.what: After his 2:30 clock-out he drives to the Ruel Road station to fill up, then eats dinner at Tess's house, where she grumbles about her knee.
entries.outcome: Tess asks how many lumpia he plans to make.

entries.what: Late evening he texts Paolo about prep dates over OPM ballads, with the phone battery already dying.
entries.outcome: Paolo replies vaguely.

entries.what: Opening shift at Heron & Grind. Jun shows Linh how to steam milk on a slow morning and pours a swan for a regular.
entries.outcome: Linh gets the pour close to right.

entries.what: After work he walks Calle Ortega and buys al pastor at Taquería Colima, sketching the Saturday counter idea on a napkin.
entries.outcome: A rough plan for lumpia sales at the counter.

entries.what: Evening at Tess's kitchen, he tests a filling ratio and she gives it a sour look.
entries.outcome: She says it needs work but eats three.

entries.what: Heat wave day one. The cafe's AC struggles and iced drinks outsell everything on Jun's opening shift.
entries.outcome: Shift runs hot but busy.

entries.what: Hot drive home in the hatchback, whose slow passenger window won't open.
entries.outcome: Home with a damp shirt.

entries.what: Evening at Tess's house, he eats cold noodles and looks up wrapper prices at Ruiz Family Market.
entries.outcome: He notes a sale starting Friday.

entries.what: Opening shift in the heat. Beatrice brings her corgi Ledger to the back office.
entries.outcome: Slow afternoon, he leaves at 2:30.

entries.what: He texts Paolo about a prep date and scrolls Lola's Roll's Instagram at about 410 followers.
entries.outcome: Paolo suggests next week.

entries.what: At night he tallies savings and costs, around $3,200 set aside.
entries.outcome: Decides to check the wrapper sale the next day.

entries.what: Friday opening shift, then straight to Ruiz Family Market where wrappers are on sale. Jun buys 12 cases on impulse without a permit and without checking his $1,800 budget.
entries.outcome: A trunk full of wrappers and a smaller savings balance.

entries.what: He stacks the cases in Tess's garage and fits a few in the freezer, while Tess raises an eyebrow at the volume.
entries.outcome: Tess asks if he has a permit.

entries.what: Evening takeout of al pastor after a long day.
entries.outcome: Early night.

entries.what: Saturday morning he picks up pan dulce on Calle Ortega and works the heat-wave crowd at Heron & Grind, since Sam texts to swap.
entries.outcome: Covers the shift.

entries.what: Afternoon he scouts Joan's Ruel Road commissary for kitchen hours and prices.
entries.outcome: Learns the $28 an hour rate and a 3-hour minimum.

entries.what: Evening he lies in front of a fan, sketching a menu on his phone.
entries.outcome: A draft menu.

entries.what: Sunday morning basketball at Delgado Park before the heat peaks.
entries.outcome: Wins two games.

entries.what: Afternoon at Tess's house, he plans out the week's cafe and lumpia tasks.
entries.outcome: Writes a to-do list including the permit form.

entries.what: Late evening he lays out his uniform for Monday and sets a 5 a.m. alarm.
entries.outcome: Ready for the week.
